name: brewvault-pdf
description: Render active Obsidian Markdown notes as Homebrewery-styled PDFs.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: Luise Rivaldo
